the mechanisms of thermal and laser-induced reactions of hydrocarbons.
the study of the potential energy surface of small hydrocarbons.

the concerted and stepwise mechanisms are equally probable.

the CASSCF/CASPT2 method has proven to be very valuable in the investigation of thermal reactions of hydrocarbons.
